verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents ROCm/PyTorch/vLLM/llama.cpp software support for the RX 9070 XT, but provides no VRAM capacity or memory-bandwidth spec for this specific card that would substantiate running a 70B-class quantized model; the '48GB VRAM' claim is generic Radeon marketing language not tied to the 9070 XT SKU. Without a documented capacity/bandwidth figure adequate for 70B-class inference, this story is unsupported.
